name: airtime_core
description: Platform-independent core logic for AirTime: RDS group 4A clock-time decode and multi-station voting, Goertzel WWV tone detection and minute-marker gating, a slew-disciplined clock with crystal drift learning, the multi-source time arbiter, an NTP/SNTP server packet layer, and the acquisition/listen scheduler. No Arduino/ESP-IDF dependencies; host-unit-tested. Headers are under an airtime/ prefix.
